info.title: MemOS Server REST APIs
info.description: A REST API for managing multiple users with MemOS Server.

get.description: Container and load balancer health endpoint.

post.description:
Add memories for a specific user.

This endpoint uses the class-based AddHandler for better code organization.

Search memories for a specific user.

This endpoint uses the class-based SearchHandler for better code organization.

parameters.name: task_id

schema.description: Optional Task ID to query a specific task
schema.title: Task Id

parameters.description: Optional Task ID to query a specific task

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session ID. If not provided, a default session will be used.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Task ID for monitoring async tasks

writable_cube_ids.title: Writable Cube Ids
writable_cube_ids.description: List of cube IDs user can write for multi-cube add

async_mode.title: Async Mode
async_mode.description: Whether to add memory in async mode. Use 'async' to enqueue background add (non-blocking), or 'sync' to add memories in the current call. Default: 'async'.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: (Internal) Add mode used only when async_mode='sync'. If set to 'fast', the handler will use a fast add pipeline. Ignored when async_mode='async'.

custom_tags.title: Custom Tags
custom_tags.description: Custom tags for this add request, e.g. ['Travel', 'family']. These tags can be used as filters in search.

info.title: Info
info.description: Additional metadata for the add request. All keys can be used as filters in search. Example: {'agent_id': 'xxxxxx', 'app_id': 'xxxx', 'source_type': 'web', 'source_url': 'https://www.baidu.com', 'source_content': '西湖是杭州最著名的景点'}.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: List of messages to store. Supports: - system / user / assistant messages with 'content' and 'chat_time'; - tool messages including:   * tool_description (name, description, parameters),   * tool_input (call_id, name, argument),   * raw tool messages where content is str or list[str],   * tool_output with structured output items     (input_text / input_image / input_file, etc.). Also supports pure input items when there is no dialog.

chat_history.title: Chat History
chat_history.description: Historical chat messages used internally by algorithms. If None, internal stored history will be used; if provided (even an empty list), this value will be used as-is.

is_feedback.title: Is Feedback
is_feedback.description: Whether this request represents user feedback. Default: False.

is_upload_skill.title: Is Upload Skill
is_upload_skill.description: Whether this request is an upload skill request. When True, the messages field should contain file items with zip file download URLs for pre-built skill packages. Default: False.

mem_cube_id.title: Mem Cube Id
mem_cube_id.description: (Deprecated) Target cube ID for this add request (optional for developer API).

memory_content.title: Memory Content
memory_content.description: (Deprecated) Plain memory content to store. Prefer using `messages`.

doc_path.title: Doc Path
doc_path.description: (Deprecated / internal) Path to document to store.

source.title: Source
source.description: (Deprecated) Simple source tag of the memory. Prefer using `info.source_type` / `info.source_url`.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: (Internal) Operation definitions for multi-cube write permissions.

messages.content: I am learning ggplot2 in R.

readable_cube_ids.title: Readable Cube Ids
readable_cube_ids.description: List of cube IDs that are readable for this request. Required for algorithm-facing API; optional for developer-facing API.

mode.description: Search mode: fast, fine, or mixture.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session ID used as a soft signal to prioritize more relevant memories. Only used for weighting, not as a hard filter.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of textual memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 10.

relativity.title: Relativity
relativity.description: Relevance threshold for recalled memories. Only memories with metadata.relativity >= relativity will be returned. Use 0 to disable threshold filtering. Default: 0.45.

dedup.title: Dedup
dedup.description: Optional dedup option for textual memories. Use 'no' for no dedup, 'sim' for similarity dedup, 'mmr' for MMR-based dedup. If None, default exact-text dedup is applied.

rerank.title: Rerank
rerank.description: Whether to apply the textual memory reranker during search. Set false to return retrieval-order candidates before post-search dedup/formatting.

pref_top_k.title: Pref Top K
pref_top_k.description: Number of preference memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 6.

include_preference.title: Include Preference
include_preference.description: Whether to retrieve preference memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will automatically recall user preferences relevant to the query. Default: True.

search_tool_memory.title: Search Tool Memory
search_tool_memory.description: Whether to retrieve tool memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will automatically recall tool memories relevant to the query. Default: True.

tool_mem_top_k.title: Tool Mem Top K
tool_mem_top_k.description: Number of tool memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 6.

include_skill_memory.title: Include Skill Memory
include_skill_memory.description: Whether to retrieve skill memories along with general memories. If enabled, the system will automatically recall skill memories relevant to the query. Default: True.

skill_mem_top_k.title: Skill Mem Top K
skill_mem_top_k.description: Number of skill memories to retrieve (top-K). Default: 3.

context_format.title: Context Format
context_format.description: Optional search context format passed through to installed plugins.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied to memory search results. Supports nested "and" / "or" conditions and comparison operators such as "gt" for fields like "id", "created_at", or other indexed metadata. Example: {"and": [{"id": "uuid-xxx"}, {"created_at": {"gt": "2024-01-01"}}]}

internet_search.title: Internet Search
internet_search.description: Whether to enable internet search in addition to memory search. Primarily used by internal algorithms. Default: False.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Internal similarity threshold for searching plaintext memories. If None, default thresholds will be applied.

search_memory_type.title: Search Memory Type
search_memory_type.description: Memory category to search. Supported values include All, WorkingMemory, LongTermMemory, UserMemory, OuterMemory, ToolSchemaMemory, ToolTrajectoryMemory, RawFileMemory, AllSummaryMemory, SkillMemory, and PreferenceMemory. Default: All.

reference_time.title: Reference Time
reference_time.description: Optional reference time for time-sensitive search parsing. If omitted, search uses the current server time.

chat_history.title: Chat History
chat_history.description: Historical chat messages used internally by algorithms. If None, internal stored history may be used; if provided (even an empty list), this value will be used as-is.

mem_cube_id.title: Mem Cube Id
mem_cube_id.description: (Deprecated) Single cube ID to search in. Prefer `readable_cube_ids` for multi-cube search.

moscube.title: Moscube
moscube.description: (Deprecated / internal) Whether to use legacy MemOSCube path.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: (Internal) Operation definitions for multi-cube read permissions.

source.title: Source
source.description: Origin of the search request. Plugin callers can use this value to route different search behavior without changing the query payload.

neighbor_discovery.title: Neighbor Discovery
neighbor_discovery.description: Whether to enable neighbor discovery. If enabled, the system will automatically recall neighbor chunks relevant to the query. Default: False.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied when retrieving memories.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number (starts from 1). If None, exports all data without pagination.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of items per page. If None, exports all data without pagination.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied when selecting memories for deletion.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Quick delete condition: remove memories for this user_id.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Quick delete condition: remove memories for this session_id.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Alias of session_id for backward compatibility.

auto_cleanup_working.title: Auto Cleanup Working
auto_cleanup_working.description: (Internal) Whether to automatically delete related WorkingMemory nodes based on working_binding metadata when deleting by memory_ids.

PermissionDict.title: PermissionDict
PermissionDict.description: Typed dictionary for chat message dictionaries.

StatusResponse.title: StatusResponse
StatusResponse.description: Response model for scheduler status operations.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of the task
